gloss: this guy; this person; this thing (rough/informal)

definitions.explanation: an informal or rough pronoun referring to a person near the speaker
used informally to refer to an object or situation near the speaker

examples.japanese: こいつが{犯人|はんにん}だ。
こいつには{困|こま}らされた。
こいつは{面白|おもしろ}い{奴|やつ}だ。
examples.english: This guy is an interesting fellow.

examples.japanese: こいつは{厄介|やっかい}だな。
こいつをどうにかしないと。
examples.english: I need to do something about this.

notes:
REGISTER:
Informal/rough. Can be contemptuous when referring to people.

KO-SO-A-DO SYSTEM:
Part of the demonstrative pronoun system:
- こいつ (this - near speaker)
- そいつ (that - near listener)
- あいつ (that - distant)
- どいつ (which - interrogative)

KANJI:
Can be written {此奴|こいつ} but usually in hiragana.

SENSE 2 (Things/Situations):
Commonly used in casual speech for objects, problems, or situations.

POLITE ALTERNATIVES:
- この{人|ひと} (this person)
- これ (this thing - neutral)
- この{方|かた} (this person - formal)

RELATED:
- あいつ (that guy)
- そいつ (that guy)
- どいつ (which guy)
- {奴|やつ} (guy, fellow)
